newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police seize 28 kg heroin bound for U.S..
newsitem.headline: Thai police seize 28 kg heroin bound for U.S..

text.p: Police in northern Phrae province said on Wednesday they had arrested two Thai drug couriers and seized 28 kg (61.88 pounds) of heroin said to be bound for the United States.
The suspects told police that the heroin, with a street value of $40 million, originated from drug laboratories in eastern Burma and they were paid to transport it.

Sombath Jintanavuthakul, 42, and Jiaming Seawang, 25, were arrested after police found the drug in a special compartment in their car as it was travelling along a provincial highway in Song district about 600 km (360 miles) north of Bangkok.
The suspects were being detained pending a formal trial, police said.
Drug trafficking carries a maximum death penalty in Thailand but in most cases that sentence is commmuted to life imprisonment.
